create_shard_writer: create a ShardWriter singleton to save model parameters as sharded files with memory management
save_module_tensors: save a PyTorch module's state dict tensors into the current shard accumulator
finalize_shard_saving: finalize shard saving by renaming temp files and writing the weight index JSON
reset_shard_writer: reset the ShardWriter singleton state so the next instantiation creates a fresh writer
write_module_or_finalize: write a named module to shards or finalize saving with the write method
